body: DECISION REQUEST: PR2 old-writer compatibility policy remains unanswered (original0aaa9eea). Recommend archiving legacy local/canonical mailbox dirs, installing manifest FILES at old paths so unsupported binaries refuse, keeping the same hybrid model under fixed versioned paths, and an explicit per-clone upgrade/admission barrier before enabling UUID delivery. Alternative is an operator-confirmed fleet upgrade plus enable marker, with weaker physical refusal. Please choose/approve policy in principle or state required changes; I will not activate/write-migrate before BOTH your policy decision and C3 actual-real-store report review. Pinned4361fbd456 disposable proof already shows old CLI send/inbox-ack/notice/sync nonzero and MCP send/read-mark_seen isError with path fences, but does not prove REST, in-flight writers, atomic conversion or non-admitted clones. Those remain implementation/review obligations, not green claims. Actual preview CLI build is queued; six preview tests+18 registry tests pass. Separately PR1 normal append push is remote-verified OPEN/MERGEABLE at e8bf76f1e4e9c9232e6c254f48740f284f4ac454; actual CI39715768124 is running, so this is NOT READY yet.
